changeSet.author: GA-Lotse
changeSet.sql:
create temp table used_person_address_ids on commit drop as select contact_address_id as id from person where contact_address_id is not null UNION select different_billing_address_id as id from person where different_billing_address_id is not null;
delete from domestic_person_address where id not in (select id from used_person_address_ids); delete from postbox_person_address where id not in (select id from used_person_address_ids); delete from person_address where id not in (select id from used_person_address_ids);

delete from domestic_facility_address where id not in (select id from used_facility_address_ids); delete from postbox_facility_address where id not in (select id from used_facility_address_ids); delete from facility_address where id not in (select id from used_facility_address_ids);
